reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies an experimentally useful oxygen-controlled comparison, keeps conductivity measurements as a prospective benchmark rather than explicitly training on them, and provides at least general prior support for disorder-modified transport in HEAs. Its advantage is limited by the questionable invocation of ionized-impurity scattering in a metallic alloy, tangential evidence, and failure to define a genuinely held-out dataset and prespecified error metric.
